plain: A way of writing each instruction's rank into the prompt as a tag, so the model can tell which instruction wins without relying on message roles.
eli5: Sticking a number badge on every order so the robot knows which boss it came from.
technical: ManyIH's scheme for in-text privilege: each instruction is wrapped in a tag, ordinal ([[Privilege k]], lower number wins, ties go to the later instruction) or scalar ([[z=v]], higher value wins), and a meta-instruction states the rule; only the order of values matters.
